name: SOCIO-DEMOGRAPHICS
role_and_limit: Optional, coarse or declared context. Never infer household composition or use demographics as the sole decision factor.
role_and_limit_original: Contesto, non determinante unico. Valori opzionali, aggregati o dichiarati; non inferire composizione familiare

name: SAMSUNG OWNERSHIP
role_and_limit: Ownership depth and category combinations indicate relationship context, not verified Luna compatibility.
role_and_limit_original: Forza della relazione e opportunità di ecosistema; possesso non prova compatibilità con Luna

name: COMPETITOR OWNERSHIP
role_and_limit: Use only explicitly declared other-brand ownership with provenance. Weak signals do not identify a competitor device.
role_and_limit_original: Bisogni e barriere al cambio; nessuna deduzione del marchio posseduto da segnali deboli

name: SMART HOME
role_and_limit: Home interests and connected-device context are distinct from confirmed product integrations.
role_and_limit_original: Interesse/contesto distinto dalle integrazioni effettivamente confermate

name: PURCHASE INTENT
role_and_limit: Keep curiosity, content exploration, wishlist, configuration and valid mock-cart intent separate.
role_and_limit_original: Separare curiosità, approfondimento e intento; eventi tutti simulati

name: CLTV
role_and_limit: Qualitative illustrative value priorities are not a validated prediction model. Unprovided thresholds remain unknown.
role_and_limit_original: Priorità economica, non formula predittiva già validata; importi e soglie non forniti restano ipotesi

name: LIFECYCLE
role_and_limit: Prospect, first-time, repeat, ecosystem, dormant and win-back states use explicit precedence and event history.
role_and_limit_original: Prospect, first-time, repeat, ecosystem, dormant, win-back; regole di precedenza esplicite

name: PURCHASE CHANNEL
role_and_limit: Observed or declared purchase preference is separate from the communication surface and its permission.
role_and_limit_original: Dove si compra, distinto dal canale della comunicazione

name: REWARDS
role_and_limit: Rewards relevance requires approved eligibility and terms. Membership does not imply a general discount.
role_and_limit_original: Benefici pertinenti e autorizzati, non sconto generalizzato

name: ENGAGEMENT
role_and_limit: Engagement timing and contact history inform pressure. They never replace per-surface consent.

name: MOTIVATION
role_and_limit: Needs come from declared preferences or sourced synthetic events. One click does not establish a certain motivation.
role_and_limit_original: Bisogno espresso o segnale osservato con fonte; non attribuire una motivazione certa da un solo click

name: B2B
role_and_limit: Professional account/contact context, industry and assessment objectives stay separate from consumer checkout.
role_and_limit_original: Modello account/contatto e obiettivi lead/demo/pilot, distinti dal consumer
